8|
9|1. `-Detach` (single run or `-Panel`): the foreground runs the dry-run checks PLUS every refusal a
10|   real run makes before the lock (launchers, active recovery record, preflight, roster, the `.cmd`

16|   start/finish/are blocked, and writes a terminal status on every exit path (`Stop-WithError`
17|   hook + the script-scope finally).
18|2. `-Status [-Id <id8>]` (0 done ok, 1 done with failures, 2 running, 3 wait timeout, 4 ambiguous
19|   or unknown id / refused option), `-Wait [-WaitTimeoutSec]` (default: the recorded budget),
20|   `-Prune` (done and died older than 7 days); liveness by Test-PidAlive(pid, start_time) with
21|   the host check; `codex-findings.ps1 -List` lines and the SessionStart phrase (running /
22|   finished in 24 h / died).

24|   ignored by the agy/muse collab snapshot through the `.consult.` prefix; UTF-8 log and status.
25|4. T4: `-ScriptsDir` / `CODEX_CONSULT_SCRIPTS_DIR` on run-all.ps1 and every harness.
26|5. Tests: `harness-detach` 46 (UNIT, IGNORE, REFUSE, SINGLE, PANEL, WAITTIME, AGY, REFUSEDBG,
27|   KILL, FABRIC, OUTER, COLLIDE, CWD, ENC, T4, GUARD).

30|
31|- `-Status -Id <id8>` instead of a positional id (a bare id would bind to -CollabDir; caught with
32|  exit 4). The background arguments in the status record, not on the command line (8191-char

1|# R12 - non-blocking consultation (`-Detach`): design for review (wave 24) (base 46440f3)
2|
3|Goal (ROADMAP R12): the coordinator puts a question to one reviewer or to a panel, goes on with
4|other work, and comes back to THAT question when the replies are in. Today a run holds the
5|coordinator's turn for its whole wall clock (a parallel acceptance panel: 15-30 minutes).
6|
7|## Code facts the design builds on (0.4.0 candidate after wave 23)
8|
9|- A single run: validates, takes `<task>/.consult.lock` (OS-held handle, released when the
10|  process ends), reads the recovery records, allocates n/NN, writes its record, launches the
11|  reviewer, waits, commits under `.consult.write.lock`, prints a summary block, exits 0/1.
12|- A `-Panel` run (wave 21): the parent process holds the task lock for the whole panel, writes
13|  one record per member, launches the members as child bridge processes (`-PanelSpec`), polls
14|  them every 500 ms, enforces a kill guard, prints one line per finished member and the summary.
15|  Everything a later reader needs is in `sessions.json` (the `panel` object on each member's
16|  entry) and the handoff files; nothing summarises the panel as a whole on disk.
17|- `codex-findings.ps1 -List/-Status` read the task's recovery records and refuse writes while a
18|  record is active (wave 21b). The SessionStart hook prints one availability line.
19|- `Get-CollabSnapshot` (agy and muse tree check) ignores names starting with `.consult.` - any
20|  new file under the collab root with another name fails a running agy/muse member.
21|
22|## Design
23|
24|1. `-Detach` on `codex-consult.ps1`, valid with a single run and with `-Panel`, refused with
25|   `-DryRun`, `-Status`, `-Wait`. The FOREGROUND process does everything a dry run does (roster,
26|   preflight, brief and prompt checks, the plan) - so a run that would be refused is refused
27|   now, in the coordinator's turn - then starts one BACKGROUND bridge process with the same
28|   arguments minus `-Detach` plus the internal `-DetachId <guid>`, and exits 0 printing three
29|   lines: the detach id, the status file path and how to come back (`-Status <id>` / `-Wait`).
30|   The foreground takes no lock and writes only the status file's first version (state
31|   `starting`), so a foreground failure leaves nothing to recover.
32|2. The background process is an ordinary bridge run (lock, records, numbering, members, kill
33|   guard, commit, summary) that ALSO maintains `<task>/.consult.detached-<id8>.status.json`
34|   (atomic replace): `{ id, started, state: starting|running|done, exit, task, kind: run|panel,
35|   members: [{position, lineage, state: pending|running|usable|failed|skipped, wall_seconds,
36|   n, handoff}], summary: <the same text a blocking run prints>, log }` - updated when the run
37|   starts, when each member finishes, and at the end. Its console output goes to
38|   `<task>/.consult.detached-<id8>.log`. Both names start with `.consult.` (ignored by the
39|   collab snapshot and gitignored by the existing patterns' extension `.consult.detached-*`).
40|3. Coming back: `codex-consult.ps1 -Task <t> -Status [<id8>]` prints the status of one detached
41|   run, or of every status file of the task without an id (newest first): the state, one line
42|   per member, and - when done - the exact summary block a blocking run prints, then exits 0
43|   (done, all usable), 1 (done with failures) or 2 (still running). `-Wait [-WaitTimeoutSec n]`
44|   polls the status file (2 s) until done and then behaves like `-Status`; the default wait
45|   timeout is the run's own budget (timeout + retries + 120 s), after which it exits 3 "still
46|   running" without touching the run. Neither command takes a lock or writes anything.
47|4. Liveness: the status file records the background pid + start time. `-Status` on a file whose
48|   state is not `done` but whose process is gone says "the detached run died; recovery records
49|   are judged by the next run as usual" (the existing recovery path applies: its member records
50|   and the task lock are the background process's, released with it). `-Wait` stops waiting
51|   when the process is gone.
52|5. `codex-findings.ps1 -List` gains one line per detached run of the task that is not yet done
53|   (`detached <id8>: running since <t>, k of N members finished`) and the SessionStart hook one
54|   phrase (`; 1 detached consultation running` / `finished`) for the current repository - both
55|   read status files only.
56|6. Retention: status and log files of done runs stay (they are small and gitignored); a new
57|   detached run with the same task leaves older ones alone; `-Status -Prune` deletes done ones
58|   older than 7 days.
59|7. The consult-codex skill: how to park a question (write the detach id and the brief path into
60|   the task's `state.md`, continue other work, never a second consultation on the same task
61|   until `-Status` says done - the task lock refuses it anyway), and when to revisit (after
62|   `done`, never before). Non-goals kept: no daemon, no queue, no notification channel beyond
63|   the status file, `-List` and the hook.
64|
65|## Tests (fakes only)
66|
67|A detached single run and a detached panel with delayed fakes: the foreground returns within
68|~5 s while the members run; `-Status` shows `running` and per-member states; `-Wait` returns the
69|blocking summary verbatim (compare with a blocking run of the same fakes); exit codes 0/1/2/3; a
70|refused run (missing brief, unavailable reviewer) is refused in the foreground with no status
71|file; the background process killed mid-panel -> `-Status` reports it died and the next run
72|recovers as today; `-Detach -DryRun` refused; `-List` and the hook lines; the status file name
73|is ignored by the collab snapshot (an agy member of a detached panel does not fail on it).
74|
75|## Questions for the reviewers
76|
77|Q1. Foreground validation "everything a dry run does" then a second, real run in the background:
78|    any check that can pass in the foreground and fail in the background (or vice versa) so the
79|    coordinator is misled?
80|Q2. Is a per-run status file under `<task>/` (ignored by the snapshot through the `.consult.`
81|    prefix) the right place, or should detached runs live under the collab root's own
82|    directory so `-List` across tasks is cheap?
83|Q3. `-Wait`'s default timeout: the run's own budget, or unbounded with a heartbeat?
84|Q4. Anything in the wave-21 panel parent that assumes an attached console (Write-Host to a
85|    console, the console encoding switch, Ctrl-C handling) and would misbehave when the parent
86|    itself is a detached background process?

17|- `codex-findings.ps1 -List/-Status` read the task's recovery records and refuse writes while a
18|  record is active (wave 21b). The SessionStart hook prints one availability line.
19|- `Get-CollabSnapshot` (agy and muse tree check) ignores names starting with `.consult.` - any
20|  new file under the collab root with another name fails a running agy/muse member.
21|
22|## Design
23|
24|1. `-Detach` on `codex-consult.ps1`, valid with a single run and with `-Panel`, refused with
25|   `-DryRun`, `-Status`, `-Wait`. The FOREGROUND process does everything a dry run does (roster,
26|   preflight, brief and prompt checks, the plan) - so a run that would be refused is refused
27|   now, in the coordinator's turn - then starts one BACKGROUND bridge process with the same
28|   arguments minus `-Detach` plus the internal `-DetachId <guid>`, and exits 0 printing three
29|   lines: the detach id, the status file path and how to come back (`-Status <id>` / `-Wait`).
30|   The foreground takes no lock and writes only the status file's first version (state
31|   `starting`), so a foreground failure leaves nothing to recover.
32|2. The background process is an ordinary bridge run (lock, records, numbering, members, kill
33|   guard, commit, summary) that ALSO maintains `<task>/.consult.detached-<id8>.status.json`
34|   (atomic replace): `{ id, started, state: starting|running|done, exit, task, kind: run|panel,
35|   members: [{position, lineage, state: pending|running|usable|failed|skipped, wall_seconds,
36|   n, handoff}], summary: <the same text a blocking run prints>, log }` - updated when the run
37|   starts, when each member finishes, and at the end. Its console output goes to
38|   `<task>/.consult.detached-<id8>.log`. Both names start with `.consult.` (ignored by the
39|   collab snapshot and gitignored by the existing patterns' extension `.consult.detached-*`).
40|3. Coming back: `codex-consult.ps1 -Task <t> -Status [<id8>]` prints the status of one detached
41|   run, or of every status file of the task without an id (newest first): the state, one line
42|   per member, and - when done - the exact summary block a blocking run prints, then exits 0
43|   (done, all usable), 1 (done with failures) or 2 (still running). `-Wait [-WaitTimeoutSec n]`
44|   polls the status file (2 s) until done and then behaves like `-Status`; the default wait
45|   timeout is the run's own budget (timeout + retries + 120 s), after which it exits 3 "still
46|   running" without touching the run. Neither command takes a lock or writes anything.
47|4. Liveness: the status file records the background pid + start time. `-Status` on a file whose
48|   state is not `done` but whose process is gone says "the detached run died; recovery records
49|   are judged by the next run as usual" (the existing recovery path applies: its member records
50|   and the task lock are the background process's, released with it). `-Wait` stops waiting
51|   when the process is gone.
52|5. `codex-findings.ps1 -List` gains one line per detached run of the task that is not yet done
53|   (`detached <id8>: running since <t>, k of N members finished`) and the SessionStart hook one
54|   phrase (`; 1 detached consultation running` / `finished`) for the current repository - both
55|   read status files only.
56|6. Retention: status and log files of done runs stay (they are small and gitignored); a new
57|   detached run with the same task leaves older ones alone; `-Status -Prune` deletes done ones
58|   older than 7 days.
59|7. The consult-codex skill: how to park a question (write the detach id and the brief path into
60|   the task's `state.md`, continue other work, never a second consultation on the same task
61|   until `-Status` says done - the task lock refuses it anyway), and when to revisit (after
62|   `done`, never before). Non-goals kept: no daemon, no queue, no notification channel beyond
63|   the status file, `-List` and the hook.
64|
65|## Tests (fakes only)
66|
67|A detached single run and a detached panel with delayed fakes: the foreground returns within
68|~5 s while the members run; `-Status` shows `running` and per-member states; `-Wait` returns the
69|blocking summary verbatim (compare with a blocking run of the same fakes); exit codes 0/1/2/3; a
70|refused run (missing brief, unavailable reviewer) is refused in the foreground with no status
71|file; the background process killed mid-panel -> `-Status` reports it died and the next run
72|recovers as today; `-Detach -DryRun` refused; `-List` and the hook lines; the status file name
73|is ignored by the collab snapshot (an agy member of a detached panel does not fail on it).
74|
75|## Questions for the reviewers
76|
77|Q1. Foreground validation "everything a dry run does" then a second, real run in the background:
78|    any check that can pass in the foreground and fail in the background (or vice versa) so the
79|    coordinator is misled?
80|Q2. Is a per-run status file under `<task>/` (ignored by the snapshot through the `.consult.`
81|    prefix) the right place, or should detached runs live under the collab root's own
82|    directory so `-List` across tasks is cheap?
83|Q3. `-Wait`'s default timeout: the run's own budget, or unbounded with a heartbeat?
84|Q4. Anything in the wave-21 panel parent that assumes an attached console (Write-Host to a
85|    console, the console encoding switch, Ctrl-C handling) and would misbehave when the parent
86|    itself is a detached background process?

6969|# a background on another host is never judged (D11).
